descriptions.text: Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling. The wearer of this shirt gains +7 to the Regeneration skill. In addition, all melee-based damage debuffs such as Stun, Knockback, Disarm, and Out-of-Breath are negated. The shirt is also quite stylish. Maybe a little too stylish. Unlike most monster-skin apparel items, this shirt will not grant a negative reaction amongst trolls. In fact, lady trolls might just want to haul you away for some one-on-one time if they see you in this.

beats.headline: Mordecai gasps at it
beats.text: The eighth of Carl's ten boxes is a gold apparel box, bigger than the ones before it and glowing with a golden light. It holds two items, a nightgaunt cloak and a trollskin shirt, and beside him Mordecai gasps the moment they appear. Carl hopes that is a good thing.

beats.headline: Better. Much better
beats.text: The cloak is extremely valuable, says Mordecai, but the shirt is better. Much better. A level-seven Regeneration skill brings Carl back to full health in as little as two minutes after taking damage, and finding it was a lucky break. Carl pulls off his jacket and slips on the short-sleeved shirt. It is cool to the touch and fits itself to his skin. The jacket goes back on over it, then the cloak, and achievements arrive for wearing loot and magical gear for the first time.

beats.headline: No Take Down
beats.text: Rot stickers, little black raviolis that run on walls and ceilings, stick to a crawler and explode, and every blast inflicts Take Down, which is supposed to knock you on your ass. The shirt negates it. Once the fighting is done and a potion lets him sort his inventory by value, Carl notes the list leaves out what he is wearing, and suspects the shirt would be at the top of it otherwise.

beats.headline: Three points of Dexterity
beats.text: After a neighbourhood boss, the best prize in the boxes is a Scroll of Upgrade, which has been good to Carl so far. Applied, all it does is add three Dexterity to his trollskin shirt. That is decent, since he meant to put a couple of points into Dexterity anyway, but it is not a great upgrade.
